g.text: Spec 031 deleted pin S1's guard. Its delete list came from reading, not from tracing.
The lint greps every live file for the path and for its last segment.
History paths do not count. They come from the same list the stale-name check uses.
The spec does not name stack.md, so the lint fails. The page for gate H1 is never written.
The author decides about each referrer, in the spec, before the owner reads it.
Now the owner approves a delete list the machine built, not one the agent remembered.
